residual_risks: This repair is not independently reviewed yet. The G0-01 review receipt is bound to 7f06517 and to the code this repair changes (requirements/tools/lockfile.py, requirements/tests/test_lock_contract.py), so a fresh review round over ca5ceb3..7641e40 is required before the repair revision is treated as reviewed.

Normalising CRLF to LF when hashing means the digest no longer distinguishes the two line-ending conventions for text artifacts. The repository pins line endings per extension, and the requirement lines are parsed by pip either way, so this is the weaker of the two equivalence classes and the one that matches what git stores.
